title: Treats and Trivia with Mrs. Claus
seo_title: Treats and Trivia with Mrs. Claus on Nov 24, 2026
description: Treats & Trivia with Mrs. Claus is a festive family holiday experience where guests team up for Christmas-themed trivia hosted by Mrs. Claus in the Elves Winter Workshop. It is meant for families. It takes place on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM in the Table Rock Event Room at Fun Mountain.
venue: Table Rock Event Room at Fun Mountain
